exitStatusDetail: native verdicts in ONE launch on the NAPI caller thread: 'm1.spike.boot PASS ... logLines=7', 'm2.bridge.smoke PASS ... logLines=13' and 'm2.session PASS ... logLines=72' (dsh_spike_complete && dsh_spike_pass, rc==0 per scenario)
gatewayBridge: real dsh_spike dispatch bridge served by gateway_smoke.cpp (the platform twin of main_cli.c's smoke backend): fsRead/fsWrite/fsScope on the app files dir exposed as scope 'app' (filesDir/spike-fs, mkdir -p parity on write), keychain honestly 'unavailable' per the RuntimeDescriptor, unknown primitives 'invalid'; calls queue in the dispatch callback and settle on the post-pump drain pass (later-tick settlement, same pattern as the desktop CLI). The host.info readiness event ({"event":"host.info","port":0}) is delivered once after eval, before the first pump pass — the same channel the desktop twin signals on.

captures.primary: logs.txt (hilog -x dump, filtered to dsh.spike lines; canonical lines byte-identical to the sink capture after stripping the hilog prefix — verified by diff)
captures.second: sink-capture.txt (app-side capture file pulled via hdc file recv from haps/entry/cache/dsh-spike-capture.log; named .txt because the repo ignores *.log; scenario.jsonl = grep '^dsh.spike.log:')
captures.screenshot: screenshot.png (snapshot_display, human evidence only, never the assertion)

note: Session run (PR-B): the merged M2 foundation's m2.session scenario (registry + the three system plugins) runs on the same launch; the smoke backend gained the desktop twin's mkdir -p write parity, and the embedder delivers the host.info readiness event after eval. First run with the merged M2 host had exposed a stale rawfile copy of scenario/m1-spike-boot.js (fixed in PR #28); all embedded spike/plugin files are verified byte-identical to runtime/spike/ and system-plugins/.

toolchain.signing: none — the emulator accepts the unsigned debug HAP via hdc install (entry-default-unsigned.hap)
